purpose: Define deterministic handling of large/legacy reference bundles (external versioning + hash pointers + retention/discard policy).

storage_modes.IN_SNAPSHOT: Bundle is stored inside RM_project_files/ (kept small).
storage_modes.EXTERNAL_POINTER: Bundle is stored outside this snapshot; snapshot stores pointer record only.

immutability.rule: Any content change requires a new BundleID and SHA256. Never overwrite existing records.

how: Compare to LEGACY_BUNDLES.SHA256 for the BundleID.
If mismatch: do not process; treat as a different bundle version.

retention_and_discard.retain_until: All AjusteIDs listed in LEGACY_BUNDLES.RetainUntilAjustes are CONCLUIDO AND required AI-only extracts exist in-bundle.
retention_and_discard.after_retain_until: Mark as DISCARD_CANDIDATE. Physical deletion happens outside this snapshot (external storage governance).

ai_extracts.principle: Commit only derived lightweight artifacts into the bundle (indices, summaries, glossaries). Never commit full copyrighted source texts.
